description: Mengubah angka menjadi kata-kata Bahasa Indonesia (terbilang) untuk kuitansi/invoice. Converts a number to Indonesian words: up to 999 kuadriliun, decimals with "koma", negatives, optional "rupiah" suffix and "sen", correct seratus/seribu/sebelas rules. Example: 1500 -> "seribu lima ratus".

angka.description: A JSON number, or text such as "1250000", "Rp1.250.000,50" or "1,5 jt". Send very large numbers (>= 2^53) as text.

huruf.description: Letter case: kecil (lower), awal (first letter), judul (Title Case), besar (UPPER).

sen.description: With rupiah=true: read up to 2 decimals as sen ("... rupiah lima puluh sen") instead of "koma".

name: terbilang
title: Terbilang (angka ke kata)
